Notes

鸟枪换炮

鸟枪换炮 literally exchanges a hunting gun for a cannon. As an idiom it means a dramatic upgrade in equipment or circumstances; it does not by itself establish literal weapons.

  • Genius community transcript
清先

The supplied community transcript reads 清先. That sequence is unusual here; the English renders the surrounding instruction while flagging the unresolved word rather than silently correcting the Chinese.

  • Genius community transcript
错过

错过 means to miss an opportunity; 过错 means a fault or wrongdoing. Reversing 错 and 过 creates the question-and-answer-like pair while changing the meaning.

  • Genius community transcript
讨口饭

讨口饭 or 讨口饭吃 can mean scraping out a living. The small mouthful makes basic subsistence the scale of the effort. Beside the insistence on getting money and running, it keeps the cash imagery tied to survival as well as ambition.

  • Lyric text
局部多云

局部多云 is “partly cloudy,” the phrasing of a weather report. Applying it to 脸色, facial appearance or expression, turns a bad mood into a forecast.

  • Genius community transcript
全场清仓

全场清仓 and 大甩卖 are stock sales calls: everything must go, a huge clearance sale. The later 走过路过不要错过 is another call to passing customers, carried here into the surrounding personal imagery.

  • Genius community transcript
老奸巨猾

老奸巨猾 describes someone deeply practiced in deceit or cunning. There is no fox in the Chinese; English supplies its own familiar animal for that character. With a loach held at the mouth in the previous line, 不会咬 works both as refusing food and refusing to be lured in.

  • Lyric text
嘴硬

嘴硬 is refusing to concede or continuing to talk tough despite contrary evidence. The next line’s 心虚 is inward unease, guilt, or lack of confidence. Together they split the person into a defiant mouth and an insecure interior; the praise of how “cool” and “beautiful” this looks carries a mocking edge.

  • Lyric text
灰

灰 can mean dust or ash as a substance, and grey as a color. 一身灰 naturally pictures being covered in dust, which is how the translation reads it. The English title keeps the color available, so the ending joins a bodily coating to the song’s grey atmosphere.

  • Lyric text
